name: Hummus Baked Chicken with Zucchini, Onion, Pepper & Tomato Stew
ingredients: 1 ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
2 (12 oz) jars roasted red bell peppers
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Transfer to the baking sheet.
Season chicken with salt and pepper on both sides. Spread ¼-cup hummus over the top of each fillet, then drizzle with more oil.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until chicken is cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry zucchini. Using a clean cutting board, trim and medium dice the zucchini; place in a medium bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add zucchini and onion; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and roughly chop roasted peppers.

Add roasted peppers, marinara sauce, and spices to the pot; stir to combine the stew and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to low, cover, and cook until veggies are tender, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide veggie stew between plates or bowls; top with chicken. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
